name: hud_ui_cycle_selector_widget_advance_selection_and_activate
description: HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::AdvanceSelectionAndActivate advances the selected index, wraps to firstIndex at the visible/item limit, and runs the base ZRD activation path.
known_limits: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4b7ee0 fails for ?AdvanceSelectionAndActivate@HudUiCycleSelectorWidget@@QAEXXZ with 36 unmasked byte mismatches after 4 relocation-masked bytes and 9 trimmed NOP bytes; drift is in the selectedIndex/itemCount/visibleCount load/store scheduling and final call/epilogue shape.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4b7ee0 increments selectedIndex, uses min(visibleCount, itemCount) as the end index, wraps selectedIndex to firstIndex when the incremented value reaches that end, and calls HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.
Native smoke zhud_cycle_selector_widget_constructor_smoke verifies both the wrap path and the in-range advance path for AdvanceSelectionAndActivate.
